description: Use ChatGPT to plan a real trip with Life Happens Outdoors. We run premium small group expeditions, Kilimanjaro, Everest Base Camp, Annapurna, the Dolomites, and more, with airport-to-airport support and LHO Team Leaders on every departure. Ask the app to find a trip for the dates and difficulty you have in mind, pull up a full itinerary with inclusions and what to expect at altitude, check which departures still have availability, and submit a consultation request directly to our team. You confirm every consultation inside the chat before it is sent, and you see our safety disclaimer about fitness, medical readiness, and final clearance before anything goes through. Built for explorers who want to do the thinking with ChatGPT and the trip with people who run expeditions for a living.
